dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual 2D narrowing of the visible body mass from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median slate-grey pigmentation across the visible dorsal surface, excluding specular highlights.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: High spatial frequency of irregular dark and light grey patches (mottling) distributed across the dorsal area.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the varying shades of grey pigmentation.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Small, distinct, circular pale marks visible on the left side of the dorsal plane.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several circular, pale marks or lesions localized on the left lateral-dorsal surface.
